name: Hidden in Gems
description: This model focused on a style of carved sculpture in gems, the concept itself is to see landscapes that blend fantasy and surrealism, giving the illusion of a peek into a world hidden in gems/geodes, heads the name of the model. I think it works especially well with sceneries, but the animals look rather cute as well. I hope you have fun with it. And it is a nice pairing for most daily challenges that include gems/ minerals.
